name: TCV Food Bank + Mobile Pantry
hours: Marketplace: Mon–Thu 10:00 am–2:00 pm; Fri 10:00–11:30 am (drive-thru only)
description: Free groceries for Alameda County residents who meet income requirements. First-time shoppers bring an ID to sign up for a TCV card; new cards are not issued on Fridays. Mobile pantry sites are listed on the website.
language_note: Website available in English, Spanish, Chinese, Farsi and Vietnamese.

name: 211 Alameda County
hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
description: Free, confidential help from a person who can refer you to food, housing, health and other services in Alameda County.
language_note: Ask about language help when you call.

name: Fremont Family Resource Center
description: A City-run center that houses City, County and nonprofit agencies in one place. Call to ask which agency can help and whether it takes walk-ins.

name: City of Fremont Senior InfoLine
address: 3300 Capitol Ave, Building B, Fremont, CA 94538
hours: Office Mon–Fri 8:30 am–5:00 pm; closed 12:00–1:00 pm
description: Resources and help for older adults and caregivers, including benefits questions. Leave a message and the City says calls are returned within 2 days.

name: Bay Area Community Health: Liberty Clinic
hours: Mon–Thu 8:00 am–7:00 pm; Fri–Sat 8:00 am–5:00 pm
description: Community health center with medical, behavioral health and vision care, plus help with health insurance. The phone number is the appointment line for all Bay Area Community Health clinics.

name: Bay Area Community Health: Irvington Dave Clinic
hours: Medical: Mon–Fri 8:00 am–7:00 pm, Sun 8:00 am–5:00 pm. Dental: Mon–Fri 8:00 am–7:00 pm, Sat 8:00 am–5:00 pm
description: Medical, pediatric, behavioral health and dental care, plus help with health insurance. Call the appointment line first.

name: Bay Area Community Health: Mowry II Clinic
hours: Medical: Mon–Fri 8:00 am–5:00 pm. Teen Clinic: Mon–Thu 9:00 am–6:00 pm, Fri 8:00 am–5:00 pm. Convenient Care: Mon–Fri 5:00–8:00 pm
description: Medical and behavioral health care with a Teen Clinic and Women's Health. Several suites share this address; ask which one when you call.

name: 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
description: Trained crisis counselors by phone at any hour. The City's Youth and Family Services page points residents to this line. For a life-threatening emergency call 911.

name: Abode Services
description: Nonprofit that provides housing and support services for people experiencing homelessness. This is the administrative office; call to ask how to get help.

name: Immigration Institute of the Bay Area: Fremont
description: Nonprofit immigration legal services and workshops for Alameda County. First consultations are booked by phone or online.
language_note: The website and booking instructions are also in Spanish.

name: League of Volunteers (LOV)
address: PO Box 1170, Newark, CA 94560 (no walk-in office)
description: Tri-City nonprofit that runs holiday food and toy drives, Adopt-A-Family, summer recreation and community events. The staff work remotely, so call or email first.

name: Fremont Library
description: Alameda County Library branch. It is run by the County, not paid for from the City of Fremont budget. Hours differ by day; check the website or call.
